# SMG Social Hub

Multi-brand social media management: schedule posts + AI-assisted comment engagement.

## Setup

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and fill in your credentials
2. `npm install`
3. `npx prisma db push`
4. `npx prisma generate`
5. `npm run dev`

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | SQLite path, e.g. `file:./dev.db` |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Yes | Anthropic API key for AI reply generation |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` | Yes | 32-char hex string for AES-256 token encryption |
| `FACEBOOK_APP_ID` | Optional | Facebook OAuth App ID |
| `FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET` | Optional | Facebook OAuth App Secret |
| `INSTAGRAM_APP_ID` | Optional | Instagram Business App ID |
| `INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET` | Optional | Instagram App Secret |
| `TWITTER_CLIENT_ID` | Optional | Twitter OAuth 2.0 Client ID |
| `TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET` | Optional | Twitter OAuth 2.0 Client Secret |
| `LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID` | Optional | LinkedIn App Client ID |
| `LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET` | Optional | LinkedIn App Client Secret |
| `TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY` | Optional | TikTok Content API Client Key |
| `TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET` | Optional | TikTok App Client Secret |
| `YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID` | Optional | YouTube (Google) OAuth Client ID |
| `YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET` | Optional | YouTube OAuth Client Secret |
| `REDDIT_CLIENT_ID` | Optional | Reddit App Client ID |
| `REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET` | Optional | Reddit App Client Secret |
| `ARCADE_API_KEY` | Optional | Arcade API key for Twitter/Reddit posting |
| `ARCADE_USER_ID` | Optional | Arcade user ID |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | Optional | Public base URL for OAuth callbacks |

## Seed initial data

```
POST http://localhost:3000/api/seed
```

## Pre-load SnapRegister comment opportunities

```
POST http://localhost:3000/api/comments/pre-load
Body: { "brandId": "<brand-id>" }
```

## Platforms

| Platform | Post | Read Comments | Reply |
|----------|------|---------------|-------|
| Facebook Pages | Yes â€” Graph API | Yes | Yes â€” Owned pages |
| Instagram Business | Yes â€” Graph API | Yes | Yes â€” Owned |
| Twitter/X | Yes â€” Arcade | Yes â€” Arcade | Yes â€” Arcade |
| LinkedIn | Yes â€” Direct API | Yes | Yes |
| TikTok | Yes â€” Content API | Yes â€” Research API | Limited |
| YouTube | File upload only | Yes â€” Data API | Yes |
| Reddit | Yes â€” Arcade | Yes â€” Public API | Yes â€” Arcade |

## AI Reply Generation

Powered by `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` (fast and cost-efficient).

### How it works

1. Navigate to Comments > click any opportunity
2. Click "Generate Reply" on the detail page
3. The system:
   - Loads the brand voice and context from the database
   - Sends the comment, post content, and brand context to Claude
   - Runs a risk assessment on keywords in the comment and draft
   - Saves the draft to the database
4. You review and edit the reply in the textarea
5. Click "Approve Reply"
6. For owned channels: click "Post Reply" to publish
7. For external channels: click "Copy to Clipboard", paste it manually

### Risk Levels

- **LOW**: Safe to post with standard review
- **MEDIUM**: Contains sensitive product/complaint language â€” review carefully
- **HIGH**: Contains legal threat, refund demand, or fraud accusation â€” always escalate to human, do not post AI draft as-is

## Comment Engagement Rules (SnapRegister)

- Start with the problem they're having
- Give a 2-4 step answer
- Never drop product link in first comment
- Only mention SnapRegister if asked about organization tools
- Flag and escalate any legal or refund-related comments

## Brand Voice & Context

Each brand has:
- **Voice**: tone, personality, list of things to avoid, optional CTA hint
- **Context**: products/services, target audience, key messages, FAQs

Edit these at `/brands` in the dashboard. The AI system prompt is built from this data at reply-generation time.

## Architecture

```
src/
  app/
    (dashboard)/
      comments/           # Comment list + detail/approval pages
        [id]/page.tsx     # AI reply workflow (generate â†’ review â†’ approve â†’ post)
      brands/             # Brand voice & context editor
    api/
      comments/
        route.ts          # List + create opportunities
        [id]/
          route.ts        # GET single (includes brand voice/context)
          generate-reply/ # POST â†’ Claude AI â†’ save draft
          approve/        # POST â†’ mark approved
          post/           # POST â†’ publish to platform
          skip/           # POST â†’ mark skipped
      brands/
        route.ts          # List + create brands
        [id]/route.ts     # GET + PATCH + DELETE brand
  lib/
    ai/
      reply-generator.ts  # Anthropic SDK integration
      risk-filter.ts      # Keyword-based risk assessment
    brands.ts             # Brand parsing utilities
    db.ts                 # Prisma client singleton
  components/
    platform-badge.tsx    # Colored platform pill
    copy-to-clipboard.tsx # Clipboard button with feedback
    risk-badge.tsx        # LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk indicator
```

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"

}

model Brand {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  slug        String   @unique
  description String?
  logoUrl     String?
  voice       String   @default("{}")  // JSON: { tone, personality, avoid, cta }
  context     String   @default("{}")  // JSON: { products, faqs, targetAudience, keyMessages }
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  connections          PlatformConnection[]
  scheduledPosts       ScheduledPost[]
  commentOpportunities CommentOpportunity[]
}

model PlatformConnection {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  brandId      String
  brand        Brand     @relation(fields: [brandId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform     String    // FACEBOOK | INSTAGRAM | TWITTER | LINKEDIN | TIKTOK | YOUTUBE | REDDIT
  accountId    String?
  accountLabel String?
  accessToken  String    // AES-256 encrypted
  refreshToken String?   // AES-256 encrypted
  expiresAt    DateTime?
  scopes       String    @default("[]") // JSON string array
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@unique([brandId, platform])
}

model ScheduledPost {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  brandId     String
  brand       Brand     @relation(fields: [brandId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platforms   String    // JSON: ["FACEBOOK","INSTAGRAM"]
  content     String
  mediaUrls   String    @default("[]") // JSON string array of public URLs
  scheduledAt DateTime
  status      String    @default("PENDING") // PENDING | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | FAILED | CANCELLED
  publishedAt DateTime?
  error       String?
  results     String    @default("{}") // JSON: { FACEBOOK: { success, postId, postUrl } }
  notes       String?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model CommentOpportunity {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  brandId       String
  brand         Brand     @relation(fields: [brandId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform      String    // FACEBOOK | INSTAGRAM | TWITTER | LINKEDIN | TIKTOK | YOUTUBE | REDDIT
  postUrl       String
  postTitle     String?
  postContent   String?
  commentId     String?
  commentText   String?
  authorName    String?
  authorHandle  String?
  isOwned       Boolean   @default(false) // true = on our own page/account
  relevanceNote String?   // why this is relevant to the brand
  status        String    @default("PENDING") // PENDING | DRAFT_READY | APPROVED | POSTED | SKIPPED
  approvedReply String?
  postedAt      DateTime?
  discoveredAt  DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  drafts        CommentDraft[]
}

model CommentDraft {
  id            String             @id @default(cuid())
  opportunityId String
  opportunity   CommentOpportunity @relation(fields: [opportunityId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  content       String
  isApproved    Boolean            @default(false)
  createdAt     DateTime           @default(now())
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Brand {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  slug        String   @unique
  description String?
  logoUrl     String?
  voice       String   @default("{}")  // JSON: { tone, personality, avoid, cta }
  context     String   @default("{}")  // JSON: { products, faqs, targetAudience, keyMessages }
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  connections          PlatformConnection[]
  scheduledPosts       ScheduledPost[]
  commentOpportunities CommentOpportunity[]
}

model PlatformConnection {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  brandId      String
  brand        Brand     @relation(fields: [brandId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform     String    // FACEBOOK | INSTAGRAM | TWITTER | LINKEDIN | TIKTOK | YOUTUBE | REDDIT
  accountId    String?
  accountLabel String?
  accessToken  String    // AES-256 encrypted
  refreshToken String?   // AES-256 encrypted
  expiresAt    DateTime?
  scopes       String    @default("[]") // JSON string array
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@unique([brandId, platform])
}

model ScheduledPost {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  brandId     String
  brand       Brand     @relation(fields: [brandId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platforms   String    // JSON: ["FACEBOOK","INSTAGRAM"]
  content     String
  mediaUrls   String    @default("[]") // JSON string array of public URLs
  scheduledAt DateTime
  status      String    @default("PENDING") // PENDING | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | FAILED | CANCELLED
  publishedAt DateTime?
  error       String?
  results     String    @default("{}") // JSON: { FACEBOOK: { success, postId, postUrl } }
  notes       String?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model CommentOpportunity {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  brandId       String
  brand         Brand     @relation(fields: [brandId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform      String    // FACEBOOK | INSTAGRAM | TWITTER | LINKEDIN | TIKTOK | YOUTUBE | REDDIT
  postUrl       String
  postTitle     String?
  postContent   String?
  commentId     String?
  commentText   String?
  authorName    String?
  authorHandle  String?
  isOwned       Boolean   @default(false) // true = on our own page/account
  relevanceNote String?   // why this is relevant to the brand
  status        String    @default("PENDING") // PENDING | DRAFT_READY | APPROVED | POSTED | SKIPPED
  approvedReply String?
  postedAt      DateTime?
  discoveredAt  DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  drafts        CommentDraft[]
}

model CommentDraft {
  id            String             @id @default(cuid())
  opportunityId String
  opportunity   CommentOpportunity @relation(fields: [opportunityId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  content       String
  isApproved    Boolean            @default(false)
  createdAt     DateTime           @default(now())

30	async function getDecryptedConnection(
31	  brandId: string,
32	  platform: Platform
33	): Promise<{ accessToken: string; accountId: string | null } | null> {
34	  const connection = await prisma.platformConnection.findUnique({
35	    where: { brandId_platform: { brandId, platform } },
36	  })
37	
38	  if (!connection || !connection.isActive) return null
39	
40	  try {
41	    const accessToken = decrypt(connection.accessToken)
42	    return { accessToken, accountId: connection.accountId }
43	  } catch {
44	    return null
45	  }
46	}

48	async function opportunityExists(
49	  brandId: string,
50	  postUrl: string,
51	  commentId: string | null
52	): Promise<boolean> {
53	  const where = commentId
54	    ? { brandId, postUrl, commentId }
55	    : { brandId, postUrl }
56	
57	  const existing = await prisma.commentOpportunity.findFirst({ where })
58	  return existing !== null
59	}

61	async function upsertOpportunities(
62	  brandId: string,
63	  results: CommentFetchResult[],
64	  isOwned: boolean,
65	  relevanceNote?: string
66	): Promise<number> {
67	  let created = 0
68	
69	  for (const result of results) {
70	    if (result.comments.length === 0) {
71	      // Post-level opportunity with no individual comments
72	      const exists = await opportunityExists(brandId, result.postUrl, null)
73	      if (!exists) {
74	        await prisma.commentOpportunity.create({
75	          data: {
76	            brandId,
77	            platform: result.platform,
78	            postUrl: result.postUrl,
79	            postTitle: result.postTitle ?? null,
80	            postContent: result.postContent ?? null,
81	            isOwned,
82	            relevanceNote: relevanceNote ?? null,
83	            status: 'PENDING',
84	          },
85	        })
86	        created++
87	      }
88	      continue
89	    }
90	
91	    for (const comment of result.comments) {
92	      const exists = await opportunityExists(brandId, result.postUrl, comment.commentId)
93	      if (exists) continue
94	
95	      await prisma.commentOpportunity.create({
96	        data: {
97	          brandId,
98	          platform: result.platform,
99	          postUrl: result.postUrl,

166	async function scanReddit(brandId: string): Promise<{ results: CommentFetchResult[]; isOwned: boolean }> {
167	  const arcadeApiKey = process.env.ARCADE_API_KEY
168	  const arcadeUserId = process.env.ARCADE_USER_ID
169	
170	  if (!arcadeApiKey || !arcadeUserId) return { results: [], isOwned: false }

175	
176	  let keywords: string[] = []
177	  try {
178	    const ctx = JSON.parse(brand.context) as Record<string, unknown>
179	    const msgs = Array.isArray(ctx.keyMessages) ? ctx.keyMessages as string[] : []
180	    const products = Array.isArray(ctx.products) ? ctx.products as string[] : []
181	    keywords = [...msgs.slice(0, 3), ...products.slice(0, 3), brand.name]

208	    const msgs = Array.isArray(ctx.keyMessages) ? ctx.keyMessages as string[] : []
209	    keywords = [...msgs.slice(0, 2), brand.name]
210	  } catch {
211	    keywords = [brand.name]
212	  }
213	
214	  const results = await searchTwitter({
215	    keywords,
216	    arcadeApiKey,
217	    userId: arcadeUserId,
218	    limit: 25,
219	  })
220	
221	  return { results, isOwned: false }
222	}

224	async function scanTikTok(brandId: string): Promise<{ results: CommentFetchResult[]; isOwned: boolean }> {
225	  // TikTok requires an explicit videoId â€” not supportable as a generic scan.
226	  // Users should provide video URLs via additionalUrls.
227	  return { results: [], isOwned: true }
228	}
229	
230	const PLATFORM_SCANNERS: Record<
231	  string,
232	  (brandId: string) => Promise<{ results: CommentFetchResult[]; isOwned: boolean }>
233	> = {
234	  FACEBOOK: scanFacebook,
235	  INSTAGRAM: scanInstagram,
236	  LINKEDIN: scanLinkedIn,
237	  YOUTUBE: scanYouTube,
238	  REDDIT: scanReddit,
239	  TWITTER: scanTwitter,
240	  TIKTOK: scanTikTok,
241	}

243	export async function scanCommentsForBrand(params: ScanParams): Promise<ScanResult> {
244	  const { brandId, platforms, additionalUrls = [] } = params
245	
246	  const targetPlatforms =
247	    platforms && platforms.length > 0
248	      ? platforms.map((p) => p.toUpperCase())
249	      : Object.keys(PLATFORM_SCANNERS)
250	
251	  let totalCreated = 0
252	  const activePlatforms: string[] = []
253	
254	  // Scan each connected platform
255	  const scanPromises = targetPlatforms.map(async (platform) => {
256	    const scanner = PLATFORM_SCANNERS[platform]
257	    if (!scanner) return
258	
259	    const { results, isOwned } = await scanner(brandId)
260	    const created = await upsertOpportunities(brandId, results, isOwned)
261	
262	    if (created > 0 || results.length > 0) {
263	      activePlatforms.push(platform)
264	      totalCreated += created
265	    }
266	  })
267	
268	  await Promise.all(scanPromises)
269	
270	  // Process manually provided additional URLs
271	  for (const extra of additionalUrls) {
272	    const platform = extra.platform.toUpperCase()
273	    const exists = await opportunityExists(brandId, extra.url, null)
274	    if (!exists) {
275	      await prisma.commentOpportunity.create({
276	        data: {
277	          brandId,
278	          platform,
279	          postUrl: extra.url,
280	          isOwned: false,
281	          relevanceNote: extra.relevanceNote ?? null,
282	          status: 'PENDING',
283	        },
284	      })
285	      totalCreated++
286	      if (!activePlatforms.includes(platform)) {
287	        activePlatforms.push(platform)
288	      }
289	    }
290	  }
291	
292	  return { created: totalCreated, platforms: activePlatforms }
293	}

Done. All green:

- **Typecheck:** clean
- **Tests:** 16/16 pass (`npm test`)
- **Production build:** passes (25 routes; `/comments` grew 6.16â†’6.6 kB from the modal work)

## What now works

You can paste a **LinkedIn post URL/URN** or **TikTok video URL/ID** in the Comments page's "Add URL" modal, and the app fetches the actual comments on that post as reply opportunities â€” instead of just recording a dead post-level entry.

**The flow:**
1. Comments â†’ **Add URL** â†’ pick LinkedIn or TikTok â†’ the modal switches to "Fetch Comments from a Post" with a per-platform hint.
2. Paste any of: a `/feed/update/urn:li:activity:â€¦` URL, a `/posts/â€¦-activity-<id>-â€¦` share URL, a raw `urn:li:activity:â€¦`, a bare id, a `tiktok.com/@user/video/<id>` URL, or a raw numeric video id.
3. It calls the scan endpoint, which parses out the identifier, uses the brand's stored (decrypted) access token, and calls the existing `fetchLinkedInComments` / `fetchTikTokComments` fetchers.
4. Comments upsert as opportunities (deduped); the modal reports "Fetched N new comment opportunities."

**Files changed:**
- `src/lib/comments/parse.ts` *(new)* â€” pure ID/URN extractors
- `src/lib/comments/parse.test.ts` *(new)* â€” 16 unit cases
- `src/lib/comments/index.ts` â€” `additionalUrls` fetches real comments for id-driven platforms, falls back to bare entry otherwise
- `src/app/api/comments/scan/route.ts` â€” schema accepts raw URN/id, not only URLs
- `src/app/(dashboard)/comments/page.tsx` â€” reworked "Add URL" modal
- `vitest.config.ts`, `package.json` â€” added Vitest + `test`/`test:watch` scripts

**One caveat on verification:** I confirmed this at the type/test/build level and unit-tested the parsing (the part most likely to break on odd URL shapes). I did **not** run it against the live LinkedIn/TikTok APIs, since that needs a brand with a real connected account + a post you own â€” if you want, connect an account and I'll drive it live in the browser to confirm the round trip, or start the dev server and walk it through.

Want me to run it live, or move on to the next piece (the untested risk-filter/reply-generator logic is the next-biggest gap)?
